title: It's ok
text:
It's ok. I've only used this for [yellow] onions, which is the primary reason I bought it. The problem is that it doesn't cut the last few layers of onions on the outside. I always peel the dry skin and the top layer of onion off, but then the outer layer and the next layer or two under that often don't cut. They get stuck mushed in the blades and are a royal pain to remove. I think I'll just start taking the outside 2 layers or so and cut them by hand rather than having to dig them out every time I try dicing them. This, of course, almost defeats the purpose of owning this thing. Such is life.
My other complaint is that you can't seem to remove the lid from the bottom body. The white lid won't come off so cleaning and drying the thing is also a pain. I had one of these years ago that you could take apart so I was disappointed to find out these don't come apart--at least not without breaking it, or so it seems.
